editorial:
Ever felt that childhood urge to stay up past your bedtime just to see something magical? That is exactly what you get with this cute little short. You follow Sniffles, a tiny and adorable mouse who is absolutely determined to catch a glimpse of Santa Claus on Christmas Eve. The whole vibe is super sweet and cozy, making it the perfect quick watch when you want something lighthearted. It captures that feeling of being a kid with a big goal, even if the world around you is trying to push you toward sleep.

What really makes this work is the funny way Sniffles fights off sleep. The timing is great, and the animation is smooth for its age. You will love the silly gags and the way the mouse tries every trick in the book to keep his eyes open. It is a great pick for families or anyone needing a quick mood boost.
endingExplained: After fighting sleep with everything he has, Sniffles finally gives in and falls fast asleep. While he is dreaming, Santa actually arrives and leaves him a wonderful gift. He wakes up to find that his patience paid off. The story wraps up with a heartwarming feeling, showing that even though he didn't see Santa in person, the magic of Christmas still happened for him.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and holiday magic
